reviewNotes: Map proximity, a YC badge, and selling products to students do not establish student founder status.
Keep existing university associations; verify new founders through university/program or founder-published evidence before importing.
SF Tech Map samples matched 1849 bio and the Mosaic legal entity but exposed block-level location confidence. These coordinates were not used.
Building/property corroboration establishes commercial address use, not proof of the current occupant. Pins are labelled published business addresses, not guaranteed headquarters.
